Observed:
- Facial asymmetry noted since birth
- Right lower lip deviates inward when smiling or crying
- Symmetric facial movement otherwise
- Ten-month-old girl
- Symmetric facial movement at rest
- Symmetric frowning, forehead wrinkling, eye closure, and nasolabial fold depth
- Normal neurodevelopmental examination
- Normal magnetic resonance imaging of temporal bones and internal auditory canals
- Normal echocardiography
- Normal auditory brainstem response test
Differential diagnosis:
1. Asymmetric crying face syndrome
2. Congenital Lower Lip Palsy
3. Moebius Syndrome
4. Congenital unilateral hypoplasia of the depressor anguli oris muscle
5. Hemifacial Microsomia
